summary: Kelso Technologies Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K for the month of May 2026 attaching its unaudited Q1 interim financial statements, management discussion and analysis, a financial summary news release, and CEO/CFO certificates. The filing contains no transaction, no special corporate event, and no change in corporate control, strategy, or capital structure. It is a routine quarterly reporting under Rule 13a-16 for the period ended March 31, 2026, showing ordinary operating results. There is no deal, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special situation to classify.
